title: GATE ME
90 DAYS
scenes.sub: A free daily challenge for GATE 2027
scenes.voice: Preparing for GATE twenty twenty-seven, Mechanical? We are starting a free ninety day challenge, and you are invited.

scenes.title: Every Day You Get
scenes.voice: Every day you get the topic at eight A. M., a practice set with full solutions on Telegram, a free test at seven P. M., and the top scorers featured in the next reel.

scenes.title: Who Is It For
scenes.voice: It is for every GATE twenty twenty-seven Mechanical aspirant, final-year students and working professionals alike.

scenes.title: Mark Your Calendar
scenes.voice: Ninety days. Day one is Monday, nineteenth October. Comment GATE ninety and we will send you all the links.
